programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Packers defeat the Chiefs 35-10 in the first Super Bowl in NFL history. From Jan. 15, 1967 at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Legendary Packers head coach Vince Lombardi wins his second Super Bowl in as many years defeating the Oakland Raiders 33-14. From Jan. 14, 1968 at the Orange Bowl in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The New York Jets stun the Baltimore Colts defeating them by a score of 16-7. The Jets were 16-point underdogs, but quarterback Joe Namath boldly guaranteed his team would win the game. From Jan. 12, 1969 at Orange Bowl in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The last AFL-NFL game before the merger. The Chiefs dominate the Vikings giving them their first Super Bowl title. From Jan. 11, 1970 at Tulane Stadium in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Colts beat the Cowboys 16-13 on rookie kicker Jim O'Brien's 32-yard field goal in the final five seconds. Chuck Howley earns the game's MVP award. From Jan. 17, 1971 at Orange Bowl in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Cowboys rush for a record 252 yards and their defense limited the Dolphins to a low of 185 yards while not permitting a touchdown for the first time in Super Bowl history. From Jan. 16, 1972 at Tulane Stadium in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Dolphins beat the Washington Redskins 14-7 to become the only team in NFL history to complete a perfect season (17-0). From Jan. 14, 1973 at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Dolphins defeat the Vikings by a score of 24-7 to become the second team in NFL history to win back-to-back Super Bowls. From Jan. 13, 1974 at Rice Stadium in Houston.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Steelers running back Franco Harris rushes for 158 yards and a touchdown earning Super Bowl MVP honors as the Steelers beat the Vikings 16-6. From Jan. 12, 1975 at Tulane Stadium in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Lynn Swann is named Super Bowl MVP as the Steelers win their second straight NFL Championship. From Jan. 18, 1976 at Orange Bowl in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Under head coach John Madden, the Raiders win their first Super Bowl in franchise history by defeating the Vikings 32-14. From Jan. 9, 1977 at Rose Bowl in Pasadena, Calif.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Roger Staubach and the "Doomsday Defense" of Dallas defeat the Denver Broncos and win their fourth Super Bowl. This Super Bowl was the first one to be played in a domed stadium. From Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Steelers become first team in NFL history to win three Super Bowls, defeating the Cowboys 35-31. Terry Bradshaw is the MVP after passing for record 4 touchdowns and 318 yards.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Steelers defeat the Los Angeles Rams 31-19 to become the first team in NFL history to win four Super Bowls. From Jan. 20, 1980 at Rose Bowl in Pasadena, Calif.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Raiders are the first wild card team to win a Super Bowl by defeating the Eagles 27-10. From Jan. 25, 1981 at Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: San Francisco jumps ahead to a 20-point halftime lead and doesn't let go for the 26-21 win over the Bengals. From Jan. 24, 1982 at Pontiac Silverdome in Pontiac, Mich.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Redskins fullback John Riggins ran for 166 yards on 38 carries to spark the Redskins 27-17 victory over the Dolphins. From Jan. 30, 1983 at Rose Bowl in Pasadena, Calif.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Raiders defeat the Redskins 38-9 behind running back Marcus Allen's Super Bowl record 191 rushing yards. From Jan. 22, 1984 at Tampa Stadium in Tampa, Fla.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Joe Montana passes for 331 yards and 3 touchdowns leading San Francisco to a 38-16 victory over the Dolphins. From Jan. 20, 1985 at Stanford Stadium in Stanford, Calif.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Bears overpower the Patriots 46-10 winning the franchise's first NFL title since 1963. From Jan. 26, 1986 at Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Giants score 30 second-half points under quarterback Phil Simms on their way to a 39-20 victory over the Broncos. From Jan. 25, 1987 at Rose Bowl in Pasadena, Calif.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Redskins erupt in the second quarter, scoring 35 points, and defeat the Broncos 42-10. Doug Williams is the first African-American quarterback to win the Super Bowl and earn MVP honors. From Jan. 31, 1988 at Jack Murphy Stadium in San Diego.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Trailing late in the fourth quarter Joe Montana leads the 49ers on a legendary drive that culminates with a 10-yard touchdown pass to John Taylor and the 49ers third Super Bowl win of the decade. From Jan. 22, 1989 at Joe Robbie Stadium in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The San Francisco 49ers, led by MVP Joe Montana, become the second team in NFL history to win four Super Bowls with a convincing 55-10 victory. From Jan. 28, 1990 at Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Giants win their second Super Bowl in five years by defeating the Bills 20-19. Scott Norwood's 47-yard field goal sails wide right with no time left in the game to preserve the Giants victory. From Jan. 27, 1991 at Tampa Stadium in Tampa, Fla.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Redskins quarterback Mark Rypien passes for 292 yards and two touchdowns earning game MVP honors as the Redskins defeat the Buffalo Bills 37-24. From Jan. 26, 1992 at Hubert H. Humphrey Metrodome in Minneapolis, Minn.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Cowboys quarterback Troy Aikman earns MVP honors by passing for 273 yards and 4 touchdowns leading Dallas to a 52-17 victory over the Buffalo Bills. From Jan. 31, 1993 at Rose Bowl in Pasadena, Calif.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Running back Emmitt Smith rushes for 132 yards and 2 touchdowns earning Super Bowl MVP honors as the Cowboys defeat the Bills 30-13 to win their second consecutive NFL title. From Jan. 30, 1994 at Georgia Dome in Atlanta.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Quarterback Steve Young passes for a record 6 touchdowns leading the 49ers to a 49-26 victory over the Chargers. From Jan. 29, 1995 at Joe Robbie Stadium in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Dallas cornerback Larry Brown intercepts 2 passes that lead to 14 second-half points as the Cowboys record their third Super Bowl victory in four years defeating the Steelers 27-17. From Jan. 28, 1996 at Sun Devil Stadium in Tempe, Ariz.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Desmond Howard returns a kickoff 99 yards and quarterback Brett Favre passes for 2 touchdowns as the Packers defeat the Patriots 35-21 to win their first Super Bowl in twenty-nine years. From Jan. 26, 1997 at Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Terrell Davis rushes for 157 yards and 3 touchdowns to lead the Broncos to a 31-24 victory over the Packers and the franchise's first NFL championship. From Jan. 25, 1998 at Qualcomm Stadium in San Diego.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: In his last game, Broncos' quarterback John Elway passes for 336 yards and runs for a touchdown to earn MVP honors as the Broncos defeated the Falcons 34-19. From Jan. 31, 1999 at Pro Player Stadium in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The St. Louis Rams defeat the Tennessee Titans 23-16 after linebacker Mike Jones makes a game saving tackle on the 1-yard line as time expires preserving the Rams first-ever Super Bowl Championship. From Jan. 30, 2000 at Georgia Dome in Atlanta.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Baltimore Ravens dominate the New York Giants, forcing 5 turnovers and recording 4 sacks en route to the franchise's first Super Bowl victory. From Jan. 28, 2001 at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, Fla.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Adam Vinatieri's 48-yard field goal as time expires gives the Patriots their first Super Bowl title in franchise history defeating the Rams 20-17. From Feb. 3, 2002 at Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Behind Warren Sapp and Derrick Brooks, the Buccaneers' defense intercept five passes en route to the franchise's first Super Bowl victory 48-21 over the Raiders. From Jan. 26, 2003 at Qualcomm Stadium in San Diego.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Tom Brady passes for 354 yards and three touchdowns as the Patriots defeat the Panthers 32-29. Adam Vinatieri kicks a 41-yard field goal with four seconds left to secure the victory for New England. From Feb. 1, 2004 at Reliant Stadium in Houston.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Tom Brady passes for 236 yards and two touchdowns as he leads the Patriots to their third Super Bowl championship in four years over Donovan McNabb and the Philadelphia Eagles. From Feb. 6, 2005 at Alltel Stadium in Jacksonville, Fla.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Hines Ward propels the Steelers to victory over the Seahawks 21-10 and Pittsburgh becomes the third team in NFL history to have won five Super Bowls. From Feb. 5, 2006 at Ford Field in Detroit.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Peyton Manning leads the Indianapolis Colts past the Chicago Bears 29-17. Lovie Smith and Tony Dungy both become the first African-American head coaches to coach in the Super Bowl. From Feb. 4, 2007 at Dolphin Stadium in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Eli Manning and the Giants shock the Patriots with one of the biggest upsets in Super Bowl history to end the Patriots' quest for a perfect season. From Feb. 3, 2008 at University of Phoenix Stadium in Glendale, Ariz.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Ben Roethlisberger leads the Steelers to a dramatic come-from-behind victory over the Cardinals 27-23 in a wild back-and-forth game that set 12 Super Bowl records. From Feb. 1, 2009 at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, Fla.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Drew Brees and the New Orleans Saints cap off a magical season by beating Peyton Manning and the Indianapolis Colts for their first Super Bowl win. From Feb. 7, 2010 at Sun Life Stadium in Miami.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Quarterback Aaron Rodgers lead the Green Bay Packers to the 31-25 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers and earns MVP honors. From Feb. 6, 2011 at Cowboys Stadium in Arlington, Texas.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: In a rematch of Super Bowl XLII, the Giants defeat the Patriots, 21-17. Eli Manning posts an MVP-worthy performance. From Feb. 5, 2012 at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Baltimore Ravens defeat the San Francisco 49ers in a 34-31 victory. John and Jim Harbaugh become the first brothers in Super Bowl history to coach against each other. From Feb. 3, 2013 at Mercedes-Benz Superdome in New Orleans.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: The Seattle Seahawks and their top ranked defense help deliver the first Super Bowl in franchise history by punishing Peyton Manning and the Denver Broncos 43-8. From Feb. 2, 2014 at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, N.J.

programme.title: Super Bowl Highlights
programme.desc: Tom Brady leads the New England Patriots comeback, with the win capped by the game-ending interception by Malcolm Butler at the 1-yard line to seal the 28-24 victory. From Feb. 1, 2015 at University of Phoenix Stadium in Glendale, Ariz.

programme.desc: Imprisoned in Russia, a man (Michael Jai White) relies on his street-fighting skills while fighting boxers in the ring.

programme.title: Undisputed III: Redemption
programme.desc: Uri Boyka is an inmate trapped in the toughest prison in the world. He is ready to make his comeback in a lethal boxing competition for a shot at freedom.

Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murdering spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney (Neve Campbell) must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s).

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss. She can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crooked cops on the take -- small-time drug lords -- sleazy informers and sadistic rich kids ready to kill --- for police detective John Shaft, its just another night in the underbelly of New York City, another shift facing down cops and criminals who want him dead and a legal system that thrives on money, not justice.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: Two 17th-century Portuguese missionaries, Father Sebastian Rodrigues (Andrew Garfield) and Father Francisco Garupe (Adam Driver), embark on a perilous journey to Japan to find their missing mentor (Liam Neeson). While there, the two men minister to the Christian villagers who worship in secret. If caught by feudal lords or ruling samurai, they must renounce their faith or face a prolonged and agonizing death.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in 1860's New York.

programme.title: The Painter
programme.desc: An ex-CIA operative is tracked down by a young woman and they become entangled in an unauthorized black ops program.

programme.title: Grudge Match

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: The Foreigner

His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full with a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary

programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crooked cops on the take -- small-time drug lords -- sleazy informers and sadistic rich kids ready to kill --- for police detective John Shaft, its just another night in the underbelly of New York City, another shift facing down cops and criminals who want him dead and a legal system that thrives on money, not justice.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: Two 17th-century Portuguese missionaries, Father Sebastian Rodrigues (Andrew Garfield) and Father Francisco Garupe (Adam Driver), embark on a perilous journey to Japan to find their missing mentor (Liam Neeson). While there, the two men minister to the Christian villagers who worship in secret. If caught by feudal lords or ruling samurai, they must renounce their faith or face a prolonged and agonizing death.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in 1860's New York.

programme.title: The Painter
programme.desc: An ex-CIA operative is tracked down by a young woman and they become entangled in an unauthorized black ops program.

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full with a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: After serving five years in prison, wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up, by-the-book sister Danica to help her get back on her feet. The feisty ex-con becomes suspicious and concerned when Danica tells her that she's in a long-distance, online relationship with a mysterious man she's never seen. As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it.

programme.title: Notranja lepota
programme.desc:
Emirju grozi, da bo moral pred komisijo, saj mu je pacientka prikrivala svoje zdravstvene podatke in zaradi tega skoraj umrla. Efsun to poskuša preprečiti, Mete pa iz ljubosumja vztraja, da mora Emir odgovarjati za svoje napake. Cem in Burcu doživita prometno nesrečo, Serpil pa čedalje bolj sumiti, da jo Kaya vara.
Efsun je mlada zdravnica iz manjšega kraja, ki ji je pomembna notranja lepota.
Emir je zdravnik iz Istanbula, ki pride do Efsun in ji pove, da prihaja v imenu njene mame.
Efsun z mamo, ki jo je že dolgo nazaj zapustila, sprva noče imeti nobenih opravkov.
Ko pa ji Emir pove, da mama umira, se skupaj z njim odpravi v Istanbul in izve, da ima mama uspešno lepotno kliniko. Ketche Cemre Baysel Burak Çelik Ebru Cündübeyoglu Berat Yenilmez Sevinç Erbulak Cihan Ercan Tugçe Kumral Gözde Kaya Anil Çelik Merve Sen Aziz Caner Inan Kimya Gökçe Aytaç Ozan Kaya Oktu Sena Çakir Asli Turanli Yunus Eski Beril Kolcu Mutlunur Lafçi Cem Kurtoglu Melike Balikçi.

programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Zdravstveno stanje Martinovega pacienta se drastično slabša, a Hendrik kljub šibkosti zavrača prekinitev terapije. Martin se spopada z dvomi kolegov in išče vzrok za njegove simptome.nnMedtem Hans med reševalno akcijo naleti na znanko iz preteklosti, kar prebudi stare spomine, Lilli pa se odloči za pomemben korak.
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. Kerstin Ahlrichs Hans Sigl Heiko Ruprecht Mark Keller Monika Baumgartner Ronja Forcher.

programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.
Pa ne

programme.title: Reka ljubezni
programme.desc:
Rok pove Ireni, da je službo dobil pri Valentini. Mojca se Janezu potoži glede Franca. Valentina od Bojana zahteva ves material. Marija Ferdu pove svojo zgodbo. Gašper Petro sprašuje o njeni mami, Irena pa spet preveč komplicira okoli Emila. Tereza Sanji pove o svojem otroku in očrni Angelco.
Reka ljubezni je nova, originalna slovenska serija, ki nas bo ponesla v idilični svet ob Krki.
Osrednja lika serije sta Irena Rot in Rok Slak, prikupna fotografinja iz mesta in simpatičen mizar z Dolenjske. Njuna pot do sreče pa bo vse prej kot lahka. V na prvi pogled idilični vasi se začnejo dogajati sumljive stvari, nekdo namreč podtika požare in seje strah v kosti vaščanom in gasilcem. Videti je, da nekateri komaj čakajo, da stegnejo svoje kremplje okrog vratu romantičnih parov, a prav ogenj zaneti prve iskre ljubezni. Da ne prehitevamo, Irena in Rok se morata najprej spoznati. Nejc Levstik, Jaka Suligoj Lara Komar Tadej Pisek Marjana Brecelj Voranc Boh Mojca Funkl Branko Šturbej Nina Ivanic

programme.title: Botri
programme.desc:
Vinko in Jadranka zaradi Stipanove afere še vedno spita pri Gotovcih. A življenje pod isto streho začne povzročati napetosti. Lara spi v Tomijevem stanovanju, medtem ko se on odpravi z Martinom v gostilno in je pri ženskah veliko bolj uspešen.nnVedrana je še vedno potrta zaradi nosečnosti in Zlatana, zato jo Luce povabi na kampiranje skupaj z njima z Jankom. Stanislav razloži Aljoši, kako je prišlo do celotne situacije z menico.
V tretji sezoni bodo Zaglave doživele popoln pretres z novimi dogodki in zanimivimi preobrati.
Znane obraze iz serije čakajo strašni zapleti in blazne spletke. Pridružili se jim bodo novi liki, ki bodo seriji dali nove razsežnosti, novo dinamiko in novo zgodbo. Mesto Zaglave bo doživelo nepričakovan preobrat in ubralo popolnoma novo smer razvoja. Turistično. Če si lahko zamislite kaj takega.
Ideja je zrasla na kanadskem zelniku bogatega izseljenca Stanislava Stanleyja Cukela, ki se je odločil vrniti in vnesti duh svetovljanstva in turizma v svoj rojstni kraj

programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Lorena je pretresena, ko ji Crni ponudi delo, Jakov pa je šokiran, ko jo vidi v gostilni. Joco izve za težave z delavci in ukradenim materialom.nnKo Divna odkrije, da je Lorena noseča z Jakovom, jo odpelje k Šimatovima na pogovor. Zrinka opazi, da Joco še vedno trpi za Petro, in ga spodbuja, naj se znebi njunih skupnih stvari.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. Filip Juricic Lena Medar Iva Mihalic Amar Bukvic Zarko Radic Momcilo Otasevic Dora Dimic Rakar Toma Medvesek Ksenija Pajic Marija Kl

programme.title: Skrito v raju
programme.desc:
David pritiska na Edija, da morata paziti, da ju ne odkrijejo, a Edi je trmast, pridobiti hoče vzorec zdravila. Odkriti hoče, kdo je odgovoren za to prevaro! Mia in Žan se zbližujeta ob vinu, nato pa se Mia vrne k Marku, ne da bi vedela, da Lara ponovno dela na kliniki. Pečniku je žal, ker se je izdal Sanji. Bojan se spravi nanj z dvema varnostnikoma.
Slovenska serija Skrito v raju nas popelje v istrski kamp Paradiso, kjer si pisana bera dopustnikov polni baterije od vrveža glavnega mesta.
Glavna junaka sta Lara in Mark, ki se zaljubita na prvi pogled, a je pred njima še vrsta zapletov, ki so resen izziv za njuno zvezo. Rahela Jagric Pirc Aleksandra Balmazovic Ales Valic Blaz Valic Gaber Trseglav Gaja Filac Matej Zemljic Mila Persin Sabina Kogovsek Tanja Potocnik Vesna Pernacic Zala Djuric Sandra Debelak Matino Antunovic Mei Rabic Alen Salinovic Matic Valic Primoz Vrhovec Melanie Mekicar Valter Dragan Vesna Ponorac.

programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Emily, nadarjena študentka in ljubiteljica klasične glasbe, skriva temno skrivnost - celo pred dr. Gruberjem. Ko se pri dekletu pojavijo nepojasnjeni simptomi, Martin odkrije, da jemlje nevarno zdravilo.nnEmily s tem zatira del svoje osebnosti, a prav zaradi zdravila se verjetno slabša njeno zdravstveno stanje. Bo Martin uspel prodreti do resnice, preden bo prepozno?
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. Kerstin Ahlrichs Hans Sigl Heiko Ruprecht Mark Keller Monika Baumgartner Ronja Forcher.

programme.title: Večerja za 5
programme.desc:
Večerja za 5 je priljubljena hrvaška kulinarična oddaja, ki prinaša različne recepte iz loncev domače kuhinje.
Tekmovalci pogosto pripravijo zanimive specialitete, s katerimi razveselijo brbončice sotekmovalcev. Večerja je sestavljena iz predjedi, glavne jedi in sladice. Na koncu večera gostje komentirajo pogostitev in vzdušje ter podajo oceno gostitelju.

programme.title: Po poti resnice
programme.desc:
Ceylin Cinarju obljubi, da bo dala vse od sebe, da ga spravi na prostost. Ilgaz izve, da so našli truplo Tugcinih napadalcev. Yekta se dobi z Lacin, ki od nje zahteva osem milijonov turških lir.nnAylin in Osman se uradno ločita, a mu Zumrut pove, da je ona še vedno poročena. Tugce prizna Ilgazu, da ni izgubila spomina.
Ilgaz je javni tožilec, ki je od svojega očeta prejel visoka etična načela glede poštenosti, časti in spoštovanja.
Ceylin je uspešna odvetnica, ki je morala zgodaj odrasti, ker so njenega očeta obsodili po krivem. Prav zaradi tega se je v svojem poklicu naučila ubirati tudi stranske poti.
Ko nekoč hoče od Ilgaza na nezakonit način pridobiti informacije, seveda dobi lekcijo o etiki in morali.
Ko pa Ilgazovega brata Cinarja obtožijo umora, je Ilgaz prvič prisiljen kršiti pravila. Obrne se prav na Ceylin, da bi zastopala njegovega brata. Ali Bilgin Kaan Urgancioglu Pinar Deniz Zeyno Eracar Ugur Aslan Arda Anarat Pinar Çaglar Gençtürk Onur Özaydin Beren Nur Karadis Zeyne

programme.desc:
Braca in Vedrano zagrabi panika, ker ju je policist Goran videl med poljubom na hodniku, zato se vsem izogibata. Vinko in Jadranka izvesta za Perin incident in niti ne slutita, da je za vse kriv razhod s Franetom. Stanislav brez vprašanja preseli svojo pisarno v Spomenkino stanovanje, kar sproži njen odpor.
V novih epizodah bodo dramatični preobrati in zapleteni odnosi še naprej krojili življenja glavnih likov.
Znane obraze iz serije čakajo strašni zapleti in blazne spletke. Pridružili se jim bodo novi liki, ki bodo seriji dali nove razsežnosti, novo dinamiko in novo zgodbo. Mesto Zaglave bo doživelo nepričakovan preobrat in ubralo popolnoma novo smer razvoja. Turistično. Če si lahko zamislite kaj takega.

programme.title: Gasilci v Chicagu
programme.desc:
Gasilska postaja 51 se pripravlja na polletni inšpekcijski pregled, kar povzroči nemalo stresa. Brettova se bori za obstanek svojega programa za bolničarje, ki se znajde pod vprašajem.nnPoveljnik Martin Pearce prosi Severida za uslugo, medtem ko se Violet končno dokoplje do dokaza, ki lahko za vedno konča Emmino kariero.
Dogodivščine pogumnih gasilcev iz Chicaga.
Serija spremlja življenje gasilcev, reševalcev in policistov v velikem mestu. Prikazuje njihove vsakodnevne izzive: nevarne intervencije, reševanje življenj in soočanje z nepredvidljivimi nesrečami, hkrati pa raziskuje osebne zgodbe, odnose in konflikte med kolegi.
Med reševanjem drugih se liki spopadajo z lastnimi strahovi, izgubo, ljubeznijo in moralnimi odločitvami, kar ustvarja čustveno intenzivno pripoved, polno akcije, napetosti in človečnosti. programme.title: Notranja lepota
programme.desc:
Emir na simpoziju vsem naznani, da bo odstopil kot kirurg in vodja klinike Cvetoča lepota, kar gre njegovemu očetu v nos. Na konferenco pride tudi Ali Bicakci, Efsunin bivši fant in priznan kirurg, ki trenutno dela v ZDA in ki ga Emir zelo občuduje. Efsun Alija prosi, naj nikomur ne pove, da se poznata ter da je ona kirurginja in ne dermatologinja.
Efsun je mlada zdravnica iz manjšega kraja, ki ji je pomembna notranja lepota.
Emir je zdravnik iz Istanbula, ki pride do Efsun in ji pove, da prihaja v imenu njene mame.
Efsun z mamo, ki jo je že dolgo nazaj zapustila, sprva noče imeti nobenih opravkov.
Ko pa ji Emir pove, da mama umira, se skupaj z njim odpravi v Istanbul in izve, da ima mama uspešno lepotno kliniko. programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Emily, nadarjena študentka in ljubiteljica klasične glasbe, skriva temno skrivnost - celo pred dr. Gruberjem. Ko se pri dekletu pojavijo nepojasnjeni simptomi, Martin odkrije, da jemlje nevarno zdravilo.nnEmily s tem zatira del svoje osebnosti, a prav zaradi zdravila se verjetno slabša njeno zdravstveno stanje. Bo Martin uspel prodreti do resnice, preden bo prepozno?
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. Kerstin Ahlrichs Hans Sigl Heiko Ruprecht Mark Keller Monika Baumgartner Ronja Forcher.

programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.

programme.title: Reka ljubezni
programme.desc:
Marija se ustraši Ferdove ljubezni. Franc je prepričan, da Mojca pred njim skriva nekaj groznega. Jan se želi sestati z Gornikom, Erik pa ga prepričuje, da to ni pametna ideja.nnRok in Vida se pogovarjata o Rokovi novi službi in Vida mu pove za Andreja. Bojan dobi skrivnosten paket. Irena se na ostale obrne za pomoč, ker je z Emilom nekaj narobe.
Reka ljubezni je nova, originalna slovenska serija, ki nas bo ponesla v idilični svet ob Krki.
Osrednja lika serije sta Irena Rot in Rok Slak, prikupna fotografinja iz mesta in simpatičen mizar z Dolenjske. Njuna pot do sreče pa bo vse prej kot lahka. V na prvi pogled idilični vasi se začnejo dogajati sumljive stvari, nekdo namreč podtika požare in seje strah v kosti vaščanom in gasilcem. Videti je, da nekateri komaj čakajo, da stegnejo svoje kremplje okrog vratu romantičnih parov, a prav ogenj zaneti prve iskre ljubezni. Da ne prehitevamo, Irena in Rok se morata najprej spoznati. programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Jakov in Petra skušata oddaljiti Loreno od Crnega. Una izve, da je tudi Lorena noseča. Medtem ko se nova uprava podjetja spopada s težavami, se Veljko želi odkupiti in s pomočjo Zrinke poskuša priskrbeti material za nadaljevanje del. Ivana zaloti Marino in Damjana pri poljubu ter ji čestita za nov začetek.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. programme.title: Skrito v raju
programme.desc:
Edvard prosi Davida, da vdre v Julijin računalnik. David noče brskati po računalniku bivše žene, strinja pa se z vdorom v Farmakiss.nnBojan zagrozi Pečniku, da ga bo spravil v zapor zaradi Stanetove smrti, če bo še kdaj delal proti njemu. Bi pa rad Bojan iz zapora spravil svojega človeka. Spopad Hrvoja in Črta se konča s krvavim dvobojem, Jana je šokirana.
Slovenska serija Skrito v raju nas popelje v istrski kamp Paradiso, kjer si pisana bera dopustnikov polni baterije od vrveža glavnega mesta.
Glavna junaka sta Lara in Mark, ki se zaljubita na prvi pogled, a je pred njima še vrsta zapletov, ki so resen izziv za njuno zvezo. Emily se pripravlja na klavirski nastop skupaj s fantom Oskarjem, a prihod stare prijateljice Sarah ogrozi njeno skrbno varovano skrivnost. Boji se, da bo izgubila Oskarja, če izve resnico.nnKo Emily omedli, Martin odkrije nevarne stranske učinke zdravila. Poleg tega se Martin trudi pobotati s Karin po burnem prepiru, Lilli pa išče način, kako pomagati Davidu v stiski.
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. Kerstin Ahlrichs Hans Sigl Heiko Ruprecht Mark Keller Monika Baumgartner Ronja Forcher.

programme.title: Večerja za 5
programme.desc:
Večerja za 5 je priljubljena hrvaška kulinarična oddaja, ki prinaša različne recepte iz loncev domače kuhinje.
Tekmovalci pogosto pripravijo zanimive specialitete, s katerimi razveselijo brbončice sotekmovalcev. Večerja je sestavljena iz predjedi, glavne jedi in sladice. Na koncu večera gostje komentirajo pogostitev in vzdušje ter podajo oceno gostitelju.

programme.title: Po poti resnice
programme.desc:
Ilgazova ekipa potrdi, da je truplo, ki so ga našli v zažganem avtu, Ferdijevo, in da je Ferdi četrti Tugcin napadalec. Ilgaz pove Ceylin, da še vedno sumi, da je Tugcine napadalce ubil Eren. Ko to izve Efe, mu takoj pove, da so mu za petami. Ceylin in Yekta postaneta Erenova odvetnika.
Ilgaz je javni tožilec, ki je od svojega očeta prejel visoka etična načela glede poštenosti, časti in spoštovanja.
Ceylin je uspešna odvetnica, ki je morala zgodaj odrasti, ker so njenega očeta obsodili po krivem. Prav zaradi tega se je v svojem poklicu naučila ubirati tudi stranske poti.
Ko nekoč hoče od Ilgaza na nezakonit način pridobiti informacije, seveda dobi lekcijo o etiki in morali.
Ko pa Ilgazovega brata Cinarja obtožijo umora, je Ilgaz prvič prisiljen kršiti pravila. Obrne se prav na Ceylin, da bi zastopala njegovega brata. Ali Bilgin Kaan Urgancioglu Pinar Deniz Zeyno Eracar Ugur Aslan Arda Aranat Pinar Caglar Genctürk Onur Özaydin Beren Nur Karadis Zeynep Atilgan Ugur Polat.

programme.title: 24UR popoldne
programme.desc:
24UR popoldne je na programu vsak dan in poteka v živo iz osrednjega studia POP TV.
Oddaja na kratek, zgoščen in dinamičen način ponuja do takrat najaktualnejše novice dneva z različnih področij življenja: politike, gospodarstva, kronike, športa in vremensko napoved. Voditelji: Petra Kerčmar, Jani Muhič, Darja Zgonc in Edi Pucer.

programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Miro in Jakov tekmujeta, kdo bo bolj pomagal noseči Uni, ki jo muči slabost. Zrinka in Veljko z nepričakovano pomočjo prideta do materiala za nadaljevanje del.nnDrago sliši pogovor med Crnim in Petro. Joco in Veljko pred bolnišnico razmišljata, ali jima bo Bratoš preklical projekt, če ju zaloti brez delavcev.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. Filip Juričić Lena Medar Iva Mihalić Amar Bukvić Žarko Radić Momčilo Otašević Dora Dimić Rakar Toma Medvešek Ksenija Pajić Marija Klanac Jelena Miholj

programme.title: 24UR vreme
programme.desc:
24UR vreme je z vami vsak dan pred osrednjo informativno oddajo.
Napoved je atraktivno podkrepljena z grafiko, ki ponuja nazoren pregled vremena po državi in z zanimivimi dogodki, povezanimi z vremenom. Prisluhnete lahko tudi nasvetom in vremenskim opozorilom, ki so postali stalnica pri očitnih klimatskih spremembah.

programme.title: Botri
programme.desc:
Vedrana skuša Mirjano zadržati doma, da ne bi izvedela za njen poljub z Bracom, a govorice se hitro širijo po mestu. Potrta Hrvojka medtem Kati in Stanislavu prizna, da je noseča.nnVinko se znova sooči s Saro, a Aljoša in Šima mu ne verjameta, da ga osvaja. Martin skupaj z Laro, Tomijem in Milico načrtuje svojo predvolilno kampanjo.
V novih epizodah bodo dramatični preobrati in zapleteni odnosi še naprej krojili življenja glavnih likov.
Znane obraze iz serije čakajo strašni zapleti in blazne spletke. Pridružili se jim bodo novi liki, ki bodo seriji dali nove razsežnosti, novo dinamiko in novo zgodbo. Mesto Zaglave bo doživelo nepričakovan preobrat in ubralo popolnoma novo smer razvoja. Turistično. Če si lahko zamislite kaj takega.
Ideja je zrasla na kanadskem zelniku bogatega izseljenca Stanislava Stanleyja Cukela, ki se je odločil vrniti in vnesti duh svetovljanstva in turizma v svoj rojstni kraj. Kmalu mu z zlomljenim srcem sledi še sin Tommy in zabava se lahko začne. Momčilo Otaš

programme.title: Ljubezen na drsalkah 3
programme.desc:
Umetnostni drsalec Zack in njegova partnerka Celeste trenirata za nastop na pomembnem tekmovanju.
Toda Celeste se poškoduje, s tem pa v vodo padejo tako njene ambicije kot tudi njegove. Ko Zack spozna vročekrvno hokejistko Alexandro, je prepričan, da bi lahko z njenimi drsalnimi veščinami tvorila izredno uspešen drsalni par.
Toda Alexandra o umetnostnem drsanju nima pojma, obenem pa ji trening z Zackom prav nič ne diši. Jo bo Zack uspel prepričati, da postane njegova partnerka na ledu? V velemestu, kakršno je Chicago, nesreča nikoli ne počiva.
Chicaški gasilci, reševalci in bolničarji imajo vedno veliko dela. programme.title: Notranja lepota
programme.desc:
Efsun zbere ekipo in jim naroči, naj se pogovorijo z Emirjem in ga skušajo prepričati, da se vrne na kliniko. Njihovi poskusi so neuspešni, nato pa se Efsun spomni, da Emir ni upošteval odpovednega roka, in ga prisili, da se vsaj za dva tedna vrne na delo. Serpil od Kaye zahteva, da brcne Efsun s klinike. Poleg tega mu zagrozi z ločitvijo, če se ne bo opravičil sinu.
Efsun je mlada zdravnica iz manjšega kraja, ki ji je pomembna notranja lepota.
Emir je zdravnik iz Istanbula, ki pride do Efsun in ji pove, da prihaja v imenu njene mame.
Efsun z mamo, ki jo je že dolgo nazaj zapustila, sprva noče imeti nobenih opravkov.
Ko pa ji Emir pove, da mama umira, se skupaj z njim odpravi v Istanbul in izve, da ima mama uspešno lepotno kliniko. programme.title: Viking Viki: Bitka za maline
programme.desc:
Vikinške otroke odpeljejo na šolski izlet. Razdelijo jih v dve skupini, da se pomerijo v iskanju zastave in nabiranju malin. Gilbi je v ekipi z učiteljico, Viki in Ilvi pa sta v Halvarjevi skupini.nnNabiranje malin se spremeni v vikinško obstreljevanje. Otrok, ki ga zadene malina, je izločen iz igre. Na koncu ostaneta le še Gilbi in Viki, Gilbi pa goljufa na vse pretege.
Viki je desetletni sin vikinškega poglavarja, ki živi daleč na severu v skromni vasici.

programme.title: Blaze in megakolesniki: Skrivnostni bandit
programme.desc:
Ko lačni Crusher nastavi pekove pekobote na hitro peko, pritisnejo na plin in se odpeljejo! Zdaj morata Blaze in AJ poiskati pobegle robote, preden bo Turbomesto prekrito s slaščicami!
AJ in Blaze se skupaj spopadata z dogodivščinami. Veliko zagat jima povzroča Blazov tekmec Crusher, ki bi naredil vse, da premaga druga vozila.
Blaze in megakolesniki je interaktivna risanka za predšolske otroke o Blazu, najboljšem megakolesniku na svetu, in o njegovem najboljšem prijatelju in vozniku AJ-ju. programme.title: Tačke na patrulji: Kužki rešijo letečo hrano / Kužki rešijo vrtiljak
programme.desc:
Dostavni g. Porterja so ušli izpod nadzora in zdaj iz zraka mečejo hrano vsepovsod!nnŽupan Humdinger ukrade vrtiljak Zaliva zabave!
Spremljamo vsakodnevne dogodivščine skupine hrabrih psičkov. Ti na čelu z dečkom Rikijem rešujejo težave prebivalcev Zaliva zabave.
Z edinstveno mešanico veščin za reševanje težav, krasnih vozil in veliko srčkanega pasjega humorja, Tačja patrulja sodeluje na vratolomnih reševalnih odpravah, da bi varovala prebivalce Zaliva zabave. Od gasilskega kužka Maršala do policijskega kužka Brona in do kužka Sile, ki s helikopterjem visoko leta - vsak od kužkov prispeva k ekipi edinstveno osebnost in sposobnosti, kar poudarja pomembnost ekipnega dela in odlike dobrega meščana.
Vsi imajo na hrbtih posebne kužko-nahrbtnike, ki se jim pomagajo spoprijeti s čimerkoli - od reševanja muck do reševanja vlaka pred plazom! In naj bo pustolovščina še tako velika, ima Tačja patrulja vedno čas za igro, smeh in Rikijevo čohljanje. Smešna zanimivost o Tačji patrulji: Riki je re

programme.title: Mišek Tip: Ne skrivam se!
programme.desc:
Mišek Tip živi s svojo družino na majhni jasi v drobceni hišici s pohištvom iz pozabljenih in zavrženih drobnarij. Z njim se podamo na čarobne prigode, polne smeha, nepričakovanih zapletov in ganljivih trenutkov, ki mišku Tipu pomagajo na razburljivi poti odraščanja. Skupaj z njim raziskujemo svet, kjer je vsak dan nova, čudovita dogodivščina!
Pridružite se mišku Tipu, ki s svojo družino živi na robu gozda.
Z miškom se podamo na čarobne prigode, polne smeha, nepričakovanih zapletov in ganljivih trenutkov, ki mišku Tipu pomagajo na razburljivi poti odraščanja. programme.title: Mia in jaz: Odločitev
programme.desc:
Mia in Paula bi se morali učiti, a kaj, ko v internatu vlada velik hrup in dekleti sploh nimata miru za učenje. Mia zato prepriča Vincenta, da se s Paulo učita v njegovi vrtni hišici.nnToda Mijino učenje ne traja dolgo, saj se mora odpraviti v Centopio, tako da Paula in Vincent nenadoma ostaneta sama. Mia pa se medtem odpravi k pretkanemu Polytheusu, ki se je dokopal do delčka Trumptusa, a se mu ne namerava odreči brez spodobnega plačila.
Tako kot ostale punce njene starosti, je tudi Mia očarana nad čarobnim svetom, o katerem prebira v knjigi mitov.
Nekega dne je zaradi očetove iznajdbe Mia posrkana v svet škratov, samorogov, vil in zmajev. Kmalu spozna, da je čarobno kraljestvo v težavah, saj želi hudobna kraljica uloviti vse samoroge in jim posrkati moč, da bi za vedno ostala mlada. Mia tako postane ključ do rešitve pravljičnega sveta pred zlobno kraljico, poleg tega pa se mora v svojem resničnem svetu še navaditi na novo šolo. Bill Speers, Anthony Power, Andrea De Sica, Luca Morse

programme.title: Punci iz vesolja: Polet domov
programme.desc:
Zoey in Kiki sta tik pred tem, da se vrnita na Lumino in s seboj odpeljeta tudi Brandona, da bi poiskal svoje starše. A narednica Mitchell ne izpusti kar tako iz rok svojih primerov in ravno ko se Brandon polni, odkrije njegovo nezemeljsko tehnologijo.nnZ zaplembo jadrnice in kartice prepreči pobeg deklet, Brandon pa se nekako reši. Samo s prenosom svoje energije lahko reši Zoey in Kiki, da odideta brez njega. Le kako se bo odločil Brandon?
Najstnici z drugega planeta se na Zemlji navdušita nad deskanjem na valovih. Njihova pustolovščina na tem svetu se pričenja.
Zemljo obiščeta, da bi neopazno zbrali čim več podatkov o njej in nato tudi neopazno odšli. Njune sanje o deskanju na valovih zemeljskih oceanov se končno uresničijo!
Obrneta se na lokalno učiteljico surfanja, najstnico Amber, da ju nauči osnov deskanja. Ko Amberina psička Piper uniči plazmično kartico, dekleti ostaneta ujeti na Zemlji. Njun pristan postane mirno avstralsko obalno mestece Lightning Point. Evan Clarry Philip

programme.title: Poroka na prvi pogled: Hrvaška
programme.desc:
Medtem ko so nekateri pari prepričani v svojo odločitev, je pred drugimi turbulenten dan. Po sinočnjem prepiru in zmerjanju Dario ni preživel noči pri Petri, zato se bo na ceremonijo odpravil sam.nnPoleg Daria in Petre tudi Manueli in Tihomirju ne cvetijo več rožice. Tihomir ne razume, zakaj je njegova žena jezna, Manuela pa ne bo razpoložena za prepir in doda, da je njun odnos popolnoma skrhan.
Poroka na prvi pogled: Hrvaška je sociološki eksperiment.

programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.
Pa ne

programme.title: Kuharski mojster
programme.desc:
Tokrat tekmovalce čaka nenavaden izziv, saj morajo pripraviti jedi iz sestavin, ki ustrezajo elementom njihovega zodiakalnega znamenja. Nato pa se morajo kuharji razdeliti v trojice ter pripraviti jedi za zabavo na temo piratov. Toda pred tem jih čaka lov na zaklad po ulicah Charlestona, če želijo nabrati sestavine za svoje jedi, s katerimi bodo morali očarati sodnike.
Prestižno tekmovanje za naziv vrhunskega kuharja se seli nazaj v Los Angeles, kjer se bodo za štedilnikom pomerili le najboljši kuharji.
Dvanajst tekmovalcev iz ZDA približno 21 dni živi skupaj in tekmuje v različnih izzivih. Najboljši kuhar dobi 100.000 dolarjev. Tedensko serijo vodi Katie Lee Joel skupaj s sodnikoma Tomom Colicchiom in Gail Simmons iz revije Food & Wine. Ariel Boles.

programme.desc:

Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.
Pa ne

programme.title: Moj ata, socialistični kulak
programme.desc:
Dogajanje je postavljeno na slovensko podeželje, v čas po koncu druge svetovne vojne.
Minka in otroka Tinček in Olga čakajo, da se bo vrnil Jože Malek, ki je iz nemške vojske prebegnil na sovjetsko stran in se boril skupaj z vojaki Rdeče armade. Ker Malekovi svoje zemlje nimajo, hodi Mimika na dnino k Medvedovim, tam pa ji dajejo namesto plačila kruh in mleko za njena otroka.
Ko se končno Malek vrne iz Sovjeske zveze je družina naposled skupaj in srečna. Ob agrarni reformi dobi Malek celo kos svoje zemlje, družina pa se mora odpovedati cerkvi in vzklikati Titu in Stalinu. Ko ima Malek naposled svojo zemljo, se prične obnašati, kot sam pravi, kot socialistični kulak. Dela od jutra do večera in razmišlja samo o tem, kako bi iz zemlje čim več iztisnil.
Ko se časi spremenijo in Informbiro pretrga stike s Sovjetsko zvezo, postane Malek oblastem sumljiv … Pred vrati je kolektivizacija in grozi mu, da bo izgubil komaj pridobljeno zemljo ...
Moj ata, socialistični kulak je nepozabna politi

programme.title: Prevarantki
programme.desc:
Dve prevarantki, prva uglajena in elegantna, druga pa lahkomiselna razuzdanka, združita moči, da bi jo zagodli pokvarjenim in izkoriščevalskim moškim.
Prva se ukvarja z manjšimi prevarami, druga pa se zadeve loti na višjem nivoju, za seveda višje denarne vsote.
Potem ko se po naključju srečata, začneta sodelovati, prva pa se uči trikov od bolj izkušene in pretkane prevarantke.
A kmalu bosta začeli tekmovati med seboj...
Prevarantska komedija z zmagovalno igralsko dvojico v podobi Rebel Wilson in Anne Hathaway, ki v obalnem mestecu na jugu Francije zapeljujeta moške in jih finančno goljufata. programme.title: Zlati sanjski moški
programme.desc:
V vili zavlada posebna mrzlica, nato pa Bear svoje dame preseneti s kampiranjem, ki vse pretrese. Zmenek z eno od njegovih snubk poglobi njuno vez, medtem ko zmeda, dvomi in zvite igre stopnjujejo napetost. Približuje se tudi nova podelitev vrtnic, ko se bo Bear poslovil še od ene od svojih zlatih deklet. A tokrat bo šokiran tudi on!
Zlati samski moški Franz ima čast, da med 18 samskimi damami, starejšimi od 60 let, najde svojo izbranko.
Na prelepi Kreti očarljivemu 73-letnemu Franzu Stärku dvori skupno 18 kandidatk, starejših od 60 let. Pustolovski in pripravljen na novo poglavje v svojem življenju je Franz popoln samski moški. Kot oče dveh otrok in ponosen dedek prinaša s seboj življenjske izkušnje in veliko topline.

programme.desc:

programme.title: 24UR vreme
programme.desc:
24UR vreme je z vami vsak dan pred osrednjo informativno oddajo.
Napoved je atraktivno podkrepljena z grafiko, ki ponuja nazoren pregled vremena po državi in z zanimivimi dogodki, povezanimi z vremenom. Prisluhnete lahko tudi nasvetom in vremenskim opozorilom, ki so postali stalnica pri očitnih klimatskih spremembah.

programme.title: 24UR
programme.desc:
24UR je na programu vsak dan ob 18:55.
Z dinamičnim pristopom, voditeljskimi pari, novimi idejami in atraktivno podobo, ki omogoča vsebinsko bogato podajo novic, je dnevno najbolj gledana osrednja dnevnoinformativna oddaja v Sloveniji. Poleg rednih rubrik najaktualnejše novice dneva zajemajo tudi vremensko napoved, družabno kroniko in šport.
Voditelji: Jani Muhič in Petra Kerčmar, Edi Pucer in Darja Zgonc.

programme.title: Ledena cesta
programme.desc:
Razburljiv akcijski triler z Liamom Neesonom v vlogi vodje ekipe voznikov, ki ga čaka še ena velika preizkušnja, saj se bo podal na nemogočo misijo.
Po zasutju rudnika diamantov na oddaljenem področju Kanade v njem ostane ujetih več rudarjev, ki imajo zraka le za 36 ur.
Voznik veteran Mike McCann se s svojim mlajšim bratom, mehanikom Gurtyjem ter dvema izkušenima voznikoma odpravi na nemogočo reševalno misijo, ki jih bo do rudnika vodila preko zaledenelih cest nad zamrznjenim morjem.
Jim bo kljub tajanju ledu, nevarnosti, ki jih niso pričakovali ter dirki s časom uspelo pravočasno priti do rudarjev? Liam Neeson Laurence Fishburne Benjamin Walker Amber Midthunder Marcus Thomas Holt McCallany Martin Sensmeier Matt McCoy Matt Salinger Chad Bruce Adam Hurtig Bradley Sawatzky Marshall Williams Paul Essiembre Arne MacPherson Gabriel Daniels Natasha Elise Kotzubei Lauren Cochrane Harry Nelken.

programme.title: Guru
programme.desc:
Ramu Gupta je mladi indijski učitelj plesa, ki bolj kot o domačem Bollywoodu sanja o Hollywoodu.
Ko ga obišče prijatelj Vijay, ki živi v New Yorku in se hvali s tem, da vozi mercedesa in živi v razkošnem stanovanju, se Ramu odloči, da se bo tudi on preselil tja. A čaka ga veliko razočaranje. Vijay je v resnici natakar in taksist, ki živi v skromnem stanovanju z dvema sostanovalcema.
Zdi se, da Ramujeve sanje nikoli ne bodo postale resničnost. Potem pa se mu nekega dne nasmehne sreča. Ko se udeleži avdicije za film in mu na njegovo veliko presenečenje dodelijo vlogo, Ramu ne ve, da bo skupaj s seksi Sharonno igral v pornografskem filmu. Sramežljivi in neizkušeni Ramu kmalu postane znan kot seks guru. programme.title: Novi papež
programme.desc:
Sofia ugotovi, da se njen mož, Spalletta in Guicciardini sestajajo z mladoletno spremljevalko. Spalletta papažu zatrjuje, da so samo ugodili Guicciardiniju, ker ima pomembne veze na vladi, s katerimi bi odložili novi zakon o davkih na cerkvene zgradbe. Janez Pavel III. Voiellu predlaga odstop. Esther sklene dogovor z Attanasiovo mamo, papež pa privoli v televizijski intervju.
Po neuspešni presaditvi srca je papež Pij XIII. še vedno v komi.
Papež Pij XIII. je v komi. Verniki molijo za njegovo okrevanje in da ga ne bi častili kot svetnika, se Voiello odloči, da morajo izbrati novega papeža. Ker ga konklave noče izvoliti, se z zavezniki lotijo taktičnega glasovanja.
Tako pridejo do blagega kardinala Vigliettija, ki pa hitro sprejme radikalne dobrodelne reforme, zato načrtujejo zamenjavo z zmernejšim sirom Johnom Brannoxom. programme.title: The Paul Finebaum Show
programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

programme.title: Franklin and Friends
programme.desc: "Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. The series tackles issues that include personal empowerment, socialization, self-esteem, appreciation of nature and school issues.

programme.title: Franklin and Friends
programme.desc: "Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. The series tackles issues that include personal empowerment, socialization, self-esteem, appreciation of nature and school issues.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
programme.desc: Philippe Cousteau Jr. is no stranger to exploration. The grandson of legendary underwater explorer Jacques Cousteau, Philippe hosts and serves as executive producer of this half-hour earth science series that examines the planet. He visits diamond and gold mines to see how gems and metals are formed, travels to active volcanoes to observe what happens inside the Earth's burning core, and checks out weather stations in mountainous areas to get an idea of how weather phenomena form in the atmosphere.

programme.desc: Carol's guests are Mickey Rooney and John Davidson; Davidson sings "Somewhere"; Rooney takes part in a wild, wild Western; Carol must choose between the two (and Lyle) on The Rat Race.

programme.title: The Carol Burnett Show
programme.desc: Carol's guests are Frank Gorshin and Lana Turner; Gorshin does his famous impressions, then joins up with Turner in a sketch about Bluebeard, who has just taken his unlucky 13th bride, Carol.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Bud's first dance is threatened when he learns that his parents are going to be there.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Jim's definition of citizenship gets the Andersons into trouble.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Bud finally gets Jim's permission to get a scooter, but he doesn't get Margaret's permission.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Jim has too many guests and not enough tickets to a football game.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Bud decides that he would be happier if he got his own apartment.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Jim is convinced that he has one foot in the grave.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: After Bud gets a summons to appear at the police station, the family panics.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dumps him, high-school senior Kevin (Drake Bell) does not feel like attending freshman orientation weekend at Fairmont University, but his pals (Andrew Caldwell, Kevin Covais) drag him along anyway. Once there, the teens meet members of the rowdiest fraternity on campus, who introduce them to the college party scene, as well as a few sorority girls.

programme.title: Drop Zone
programme.desc: A daring prison break from an airliner at 30,000 feet leaves U.S. Marshal Pete Nessip (Wesley Snipes) mourning a brother and gunning for revenge. After being ordered to turn in his badge, he seeks out Jessie Crossman (Yancy Butler), a noted skydiver, and offers to sponsor her crew for the annual Independence Day parachuting show in Washington, D.C., if she trains him. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind the mid-air jailbreak (Gary Busey) is planning a daring computer theft on Independence Day.

programme.title: About Time
programme.desc: When Tim Lake (Domhnall Gleeson) is 21, his father (Bill Nighy) tells him a secret: The men in their family can travel through time. Although he can't change history, Tim resolves to improve his life by getting a girlfriend. He meets Mary (Rachel McAdams), falls in love and finally wins her heart via time-travel and a little cunning. However, as his unusual life progresses, Tim finds that his special ability can't shield him and those he loves from the problems of ordinary life.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss. She can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: The Soloist
programme.desc: Los Angeles columnist Steve Lopez (Robert Downey Jr.) has reached an impasse in his life. His marriage is on the rocks, and he's disillusioned with his job. Then, while wandering through L.A.'s Skid Row, he spots a homeless man (Jamie Foxx) playing a two-stringed violin with a virtuoso's skill. Lopez initially thinks of the man, named Nathaniel Ayers, as just a story idea. But as he begins to unravel the mystery of Ayers' strange fate, Lopez realizes that a change is happening within himself.

programme.title: About Time
programme.desc: When Tim Lake (Domhnall Gleeson) is 21, his father (Bill Nighy) tells him a secret: The men in their family can travel through time. Although he can't change history, Tim resolves to improve his life by getting a girlfriend. He meets Mary (Rachel McAdams), falls in love and finally wins her heart via time-travel and a little cunning. However, as his unusual life progresses, Tim finds that his special ability can't shield him and those he loves from the problems of ordinary life.

Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?
